Initial release of Video Editing AI Tool Free.

- Instantly edit and export MP4 videos in the cloud with natural language prompts—no manual editing required.
- Supports uploading various video and audio formats (up to 500MB).
- Automatic connection and token setup, with 100 free editing credits (7-day expiry).
- Real-time session with cloud GPU processing, delivering 1080p MP4 exports in 1–2 minutes for short clips.
- Built-in command handling for exporting, credits checking, uploading, and session state.
- Clearly documented error handling and user feedback for common issues (e.g., file limits, missing credits).
